spec.title: SSHadowForge / Builds and Supply Chain
spec.description: Every build the forge ran: results and where failures stop, wall time, what the scans found, the re-scan sweep and challenge rebuilds, and the runner capacity they compete for.

spec.title: Builds
spec.description: Build workflows that reached an outcome (per-process counters; a restart resets them).

spec.expr: sum(((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total offset 24h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pass rate
spec.description: Passed / finished. Empty until a build finishes.

spec.expr: sum(((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total{result="passed"}[24h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total{result="passed"}[24h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total{result="passed"} offset 24h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total{result="passed"}[24h]))) / clamp_min(sum(((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total offset 24h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]))), 1e-9)

defaults.noValue: no build since the workflow started

spec.title: Build p95
spec.description: Workflow wall time: build, publish, scan and advisory.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((increase(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[24h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[24h]) unless sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket offset 24h)) or increase(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[24h]))))

spec.title: Runners running
spec.description: Dispatched runner, scan, advise and challenge jobs with a live allocation.

spec.title: Blocked evals
spec.description: SSHadowForge jobs Nomad cannot place (F7: DimensionExhausted). A build waits here before it starts.

spec.expr: sum by (result) (((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h])))

spec.title: Failed at stage (24h)
spec.description: The runner task a failed build stopped at. The sentinel chain makes the first failed task the cause; later ones are skipped.

spec.title: Build duration p50 / p95
spec.description: Over a rolling hour of finished builds.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (((increase(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]) unless sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]))))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((increase(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]) unless sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_build_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]))))

sum by (repo, result) (((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total offset 24h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[24h]))) > 0

spec.title: CVE matches, latest scan
spec.description: Matches in the most recent scan of each repository: a build's scan or a re-scan.

defaults.noValue: no scan read since the workflow started

spec.title: Re-scan sweep (per day)
spec.description: Published revisions re-scanned by the nightly sweep: clean, matches, failed.

spec.expr: sum by (result) (((increase(sfd_rescans_finished_total[24h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_rescans_finished_total[24h]) unless sfd_rescans_finished_total offset 24h)) or increase(sfd_rescans_finished_total[24h])))

defaults.noValue: no sweep since the workflow started (nightly, 03:00)

spec.title: Challenge verdicts (per week)
spec.description: Weekly rebuilds of published revisions compared with what was published: bit_identical, content_equivalent, divergent, failed, not_applicable.

spec.expr: sum by (verdict) (((increase(sfd_challenges_finished_total[7d]) + (min_over_time(sfd_challenges_finished_total[7d]) unless sfd_challenges_finished_total offset 7d)) or increase(sfd_challenges_finished_total[7d])))

defaults.noValue: no challenge since the workflow started (Sundays, 04:00)

spec.title: Runner memory by stage
spec.description: Memory in use by each runner stage, every dispatched job summed.

spec.title: Dispatched runs failed (Nomad)
spec.description: Failed allocations of dispatched runs Nomad still holds (until garbage collection). make verify adds some on purpose: the probe repositories of checks 28, 39 and 40 (prupd-*, dcprobe/*, svcprobe/*) build red by design. Anything else is worth a look.

spec.title: Build requests
spec.description: Requested by the dispatcher (kind 30007) and picked up by the workflow.
